records.title: Lake-first evidence boundary
records.text: Lake-first evidence keeps approved source snapshots and manifests in durable landing and Bronze objects. A serving API is a projection and must retain lineage back to the source checksum.

records.title: Provider-neutral reference app
records.text: A reference app remains provider-neutral and local until owner review approves a remote model or deployment. The baseline may use a deterministic adapter without external credentials.

records.title: Universal runtime records
records.text: Universal runtime records connect intake, discovery, architecture, design, delivery-plan, data-and-model, build, integration, verify, release, operate, improve, handoff-or-retire, and review.
